in_sanskrit.name: अमोघ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Absence of any mistake, omission or failure. Unfailing, infallible, invincible, unbroken, uninterrupted, unspoilt, perfect, complete.

in_hindi.name: अमोघ
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमावश्य (amāvaśya): Unfailing, infallible, invincible, unbroken, uninterrupted, unspoilt, perfect, complete.

in_tamil.name: அமோக
in_tamil.long_meaning: அமர்க்குப் பெறு (amarkkup peṟu): To obtain what is desired without any hindrance or obstacle. To accomplish what one sets out to do without failure.

in_telugu.name: అమోఘ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆశేశ (āśeśa): Unfailing, infallible, invincible, unbroken, uninterrupted, unspoilt, perfect, complete.

in_marathi.name: Amogha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amogha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amogha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amoga’, which means ‘undefeated’, ‘invincible’, or ‘immeasurable’. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and carries a strong spiritual connotation, symbolizing courage, determination, and the power to overcome challenges.
